content.text: {"name":"EditorToolset.LogsToolset","version":"1.0","description":"提供用于读取虚幻引擎输出日志和控制\n日志类别详细程度的工具。","tools":[{"description":"设置日志类别的冗长度级别。","name":"EditorToolset.LogsToolset.SetVerbosity","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string","description":"日志类别名称，例如“LogTemp”。","default":"LogsToolset"},"verbosity":{"type":"string","description":"详细程度：\"NoLogging\"、\"Fatal\"、\"Error\"、 \"Warning\"、\"Display\"、\"Log\"、\"Verbose\"或\"VeryVerbose\"之一。"}},"required":["verbosity"]}},{"description":"返回日志类别的当前冗长度级别。","name":"EditorToolset.LogsToolset.GetVerbosity","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string","description":"日志类别名称，例如“LogTemp”。","default":"LogsToolset"}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"字符串形式的冗长度：“nologGing”，“Fatal”，“错误”， “警告 ”、“显示屏”、“日志”、“VeryVerbose”或“VeryVerbose”。如果找不到该类别 则引发脚本错误。"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"返回来自当前会话的日志文件的日志条目。","name":"EditorToolset.LogsToolset.GetLogEntries","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string","description":"如果非空，则只返回此日志类别中的条目（例如\"LogTemp\")。","default":"LogsToolset"},"pattern":{"type":"string","description":"如果非空，则只返回文本与此正则表达式 匹配的条目。"},"maxEntries":{"type":"integer","description":"要返回的最大条目数，取自日志末尾。 通过0表示无限制。默认为1000。","default":1000}},"required":["pattern"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"按时间顺序排列的匹配日志条目列表。"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"返回已注册日志类别的排序列表。","name":"EditorToolset.LogsToolset.GetLogCategories","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"filter":{"type":"string"}},"required":["filter"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"日志类别名称的排序列表（例如[\"LogBlueprint\", \"LogTemp\"])。"}},"required":["returnValue"]}}]}
